P A C I F I C A - L E V E L E X P E C T A T I O N S
The assertive stance, artful lines and elevated amenities of Chrysler Pacifica make it a clear
standout in its category, taking family functionality to a whole new level. It’s considered
an innovator in virtually every aspect: luxurious interior seating and appointments, ingenious
storage and entry innovations, boredom-busting entertainment systems, confidence-
building safety and performance features, eco-conscious power solutions ... in short,
Pacifica both defies and redefines the meaning of “minivan.”
